name: keepwarm
description: A prompt-cache keepalive for idle Claude Code sessions, and the plugin that keeps it quiet.

plugins.name: keepwarm-bundle
plugins.description: Install this one: it pulls in keepwarm and keepwarm-quiet.

plugins.name: keepwarm
plugins.description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm so the next message you type reads from cache instead of paying a full cache write.

plugins.name: keepwarm-quiet
plugins.description: Blanks the transcript rows the keepalive leaves behind.

plugins.name: keepwarm-shell
plugins.description: The keepalive without function hooks, as a background monitor. Only for sessions that cannot run the mod.
